answer: Proof-of-replication storage: each identity must seal a unique 1 GiB file derived from its own key and keep it available, answering 3 random Merkle challenges every epoch within 2 seconds. Sealing takes about 30 minutes of sequential work, so a wanderer cannot copy one replica under 100 names. Every extra fake needs another 1 GiB of disk and its own sealing run, so cost grows linearly. A valid signal is a short proof that voyage-ready validators check against the on-chain root.
